payload.text: **Two full bats suites at once on one machine can break each other.** 2026-09-16: dc's and vc's full runs at 356ea8d overlapped under one $TMPDIR; dc's lost runlog.bats 946-948 to 'unexpected EOF' in bats' preprocessed .src copy (1210 of 1213 executed, rc 1, nothing not-ok), while vc's run and runlog.bats alone were clean. Cause not proven. A reviewer re-running the builder's suite should say so first so the two do not overlap, or accept one run as the count.
